name: Smooth Rod 8 mm
summary: 8 mm hardened linear shaft, 300 mm long
description: A straight 8 mm guide rod, 300 mm long, with lightly chamfered ends.
source: 8 mm is the standard nominal outside diameter for LM8UU linear bearing shafting and is confirmed by the bore sizes of the LM8UU and LM8LUU bearings listed on their datasheets; the 300 mm length is a common retail cut length and is set as a modelling default rather than a fixed product dimension.
